checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: expose the camera path library through the editor API - save_camera_path, delete_camera_path, restore_camera_path and preview_camera_path actions, editor schema 63, a camera_path_dir backed by CameraPathLibrary, editor document camera_paths/trash.camera_paths/camera_path_preview/workspace.camera_path_dir, a --camera-path-dir CLI flag with a project paths default, web schema examples and required fields, and docs

impact_assessment.why: Camera paths could be saved from Python but the editor and AI clients could not list, save, delete, restore or preview them, so the newest camera asset type stopped at the console boundary while clips, machines, materials and scenes were all authorable through /api/editor.
impact_assessment.benefits: Authored camera moves become a full editor asset with the same lifecycle as clips and state machines, a non-mutating pose preview for AI evidence, and one discovery surface that lists the new actions and required fields.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: four editor actions, editor schema 63, two editor document keys plus workspace.camera_path_dir and a CLI flag; dependency: server reuses CameraPathLibrary and camera_path documents; concurrency: unchanged, the session lock still guards the library; state: no scene, snapshot or render format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every payload through the document parser, reuse the existing 404/400 error mapping and trash semantics, pin lifecycle, validation, collision and missing-library behaviour in tests, keep every editor action backed by a schema example, and verify the canonical hash and reference PNG unchanged

impact_assessment.why: The API could manage camera paths but a human had no way to load one for editing or see a sampled pose in the viewport, unlike clips and state machines that already had console panels.
impact_assessment.benefits: Camera paths become a first-class console asset with a visible preview, so cutscene authoring no longer needs hand-written JSON round trips to the filesystem.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one new editor action, editor schema 64, one editor document key, new console ids; dependency: console reuses the existing camera bookmark API; concurrency: unchanged session lock; state: no scene, snapshot or render format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate through the document parser, reuse the 404/400 mapping, pin the action and static bindings in tests, smoke the panel in a real browser, and keep the canonical hash and reference PNG unchanged

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: author camera path keys without hand-written JSON - CameraKey.from_camera/from_view plus camera_key_from_dict, pure insert_camera_key/remove_camera_key helpers, set_camera_path_key/remove_camera_path_key editor actions (schema 65) that capture the scene camera or an explicit viewport pose, console Set key from view/Remove key buttons, and a fix so preview_camera_path no longer marks the scene dirty

impact_assessment.why: Paths could be saved and previewed, but every key had to be typed as JSON with a quaternion, unlike animation clips that capture the current transform; and previewing a path marked the scene dirty even though it never touches it.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cutscene keys become one click from the viewport, loops and one-shot paths stay validated through the same document rules, and the dirty indicator stops lying after a preview.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: four engine exports, two editor actions, editor schema 65, one editor document key and a dirty-state classification; dependency: server reuses CameraPathLibrary and camera path documents; concurrency: unchanged session lock; state: no scene, snapshot or render format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep insert/remove pure and unit-tested, validate times and poses through the existing helpers, pin the dirty-state regression and the action reports in tests, smoke the console panel in a browser, and keep the canonical hash and reference PNG unchanged

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Implemented and verified - CameraKey.from_view/from_camera invert the pose heading with camera pitch clamping, camera_key_from_dict parses one key and camera_path_from_dict reuses it, insert_camera_key/remove_camera_key are pure editors that sort keys, replace within 1e-6s at the existing time, keep loop shape and refuse unanchoring or emptying a path; editor schema 65 adds set_camera_path_key and remove_camera_path_key (scene camera or position with quaternion or yaw/pitch), both report camera_path_key and refresh camera_path_document, all three camera path library actions are scene-neutral so preview no longer marks the scene dirty; the console adds Set key from view and Remove key with a pluralized readout; README, AI_GUIDE, ARCHITECTURE, CHANGELOG, ADR-265 updated and the UI contract fast_timeout raised to 240s after the 120s proof timed out twice on a loaded machine while the suite itself passes in 68s; browser smoke confirmed 1 key with scene fov, 2 keys after t=2, a removal, and a preview readout at the sampled pose; full pytest 1454 tests and ruff pass, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; ui begin/verify/finish --reviewed recorded

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: expose the camera path library's existing rename and duplicate through the editor API - rename_camera_path and duplicate_camera_path actions (editor schema 66) taking name plus new_name, mapping collisions to 400 and missing entries to 404, refreshing camera_path_document under the new name, console Path name/New name inputs with Rename and Duplicate buttons, web schema examples and required fields, tests and docs

impact_assessment.why: CameraPathLibrary has supported rename and duplicate since it shipped, but the editor and console could not reach them while state machines expose both actions, so a copied cutscene route required saving a new JSON document by hand.
impact_assessment.benefits: Camera paths reach lifecycle parity with clips and state machines: an authored route can be renamed or forked from the console and API without touching files, and the panel keeps editing the new entry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two editor actions, editor schema 66, a new console input and two buttons; dependency: server reuses CameraPathLibrary rename/duplicate; concurrency: unchanged session lock; state: no scene, snapshot or render format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the library's collision and traversal guards, pin success, collision, missing-entry and missing-library behaviour in web tests, keep one web schema example per action, smoke the panel in a browser, and verify the canonical hash and reference PNG unchanged
